pivots.stem: What did the professor say the comparison of Vaissalu's drawings with the surviving stones showed?

pivots.stem: What does the professor suggest the project will do about the stones that have not been located?

pivots.stem: What does the professor imply the group plans to do next?

pivots.stem: What does the professor imply the editors will do next?
